description: Use when you need the full evidence around one target page before deciding or reporting: the page dossier (search, traffic, crawler, AI, index, audit, vitals, links) joined with six months of archived GSC totals, the cached 28-day query rows for that page, cached SERP snapshots for its top queries, competitor gap rows from the parent site, site context (domain, locales, notes, tech/platform) and recent worklog entries. Read-only and archive/cache only — it never calls Search Console, GA4 or any vendor, so a missing archive, query cache or snapshot is an explicit na with a reason, not zero. Do not use it as a replacement for get_page_report: that tool is the page dossier itself; this one adds the surrounding cross-source context.

days.description: Page dossier window; SERP snapshots always use the last 30 days

url.description: Absolute page URL on the site, or a site-relative path such as /pricing

name: get_evidence
title: Cross-source evidence for one page
